about: Third held-out set (English and Chinese): written on 2026-10-18 BEFORE the round-5 keyword-rule fixes and new train examples, weighted toward the patterns fixed in that round (questions that look like payments, pending/unpaid vs status, runway vs balance, rate alerts, not-arrived vs status, quota), and never used for tuning. Same authors as the router: out-of-sample for the matcher, not independent.
